name: Country Roads Huntington 2024
information:
This competition takes place at a hotel, with which we have reserved a block of rooms at a discounted rate. To book, visit [this page](https://www.hilton.com/en/book/reservation/deeplink/?ctyhocn=HTSDTDT&groupCode=CDT90R&arrivaldate=2024-05-17&departuredate=2024-05-18&cid=OM,WW,HILTONLINK,EN,DirectLink&fromId=HILTONLINKDIRECT). We have the block reserved for the night of Friday, May 17th with breakfast included. The deadline to book under the discounted rate is Saturday, May 4th.

First-time competitors should be present for check-in between 8AM and 8:30AM.

---

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
